title: Incident Heuristics Oracle: OpsCLI assistant for telemetry-driven remediation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an "Incident Heuristics Oracle" integrated into the OpsCLI that ingests service telemetry (SLO alerts, traces, error rates, recent deploys) and recommends a ranked set of idempotent remediation actions ('patchlets') and curated runbook tasks. The oracle should: 1) produce a short rationale for each recommendation, 2) map to existing playlets/runbook fragments, 3) identify when human approval is required, and 4) surface safety gates and rollout suggestions for risky fixes. This ticket covers the MVP: heuristic model, OpsCLI UX, mapping layer to runbook fragments, and an audit trail. Non-goals: automated unapproved remediation, new telemetry sources beyond SLO/trace/logs for MVP.
acceptance_criteria: OpsCLI command `rwin heuristics <incident-id>` returns >=1 and <=5 ranked remediation suggestions with rationale
Each suggestion links to a runbook fragment key or exact script and a GitHub PR template (if code change)
Safety gate flags if suggestion is non-idempotent or requires escalations; CLI prevents execution without explicit `--approve` and `--dry-run` support
All suggestions recorded in audit log (user, timestamp, incident-id, chosen action) stored in internal bucket and visible in Console under project Internal Ops Platform
Unit tests for heuristic ranking and mapping to runbook fragments with coverage >=70%

2025-02-28 - Leon Chen: Implemented mapping layer to runbook fragments using tag-matching; added telemetry->tag extractor. Opened RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/45
2025-03-04 - Security: requested KMS encryption for audit logs and RBAC check before remediations; flagged security_review_required. Action: add encryption and SSO check before --approve executes.
notes: Trade-offs considered: start with deterministic heuristics (pattern + anomaly score) rather than full ML model to avoid drift and explainability issues.
Fallback plan: if mapping to runbook fragment fails, surface human-facing suggested search terms and related incidents.
Long-term: tune ranking with reinforcement signal from chosen actions and incident resolution success metrics.
